apps.name: YouTube
apps.subtitle: Shorts removed (tab + feed).
apps.localizedDescription:
YouTube with Shorts permanently removed.

The NoShortsEver tweak unconditionally strips:
• The Shorts button in the navigation bar
• Shorts shelves and cells in feeds, search results, and channels
• Any Short that still opens is reopened in the normal video player

Base: YouTube 21.28.3 with stock YTLite 5.2b3 (ad-blocking, background playback).
apps.versionDescription: YouTube 21.28.3 (passes the forced-update wall that blocks 19.33.2 and 20.32.4) paired with stock YTLite 5.2b3 instead of 5.2.2. Issue #364 reports 5.2b3 playing fine where 5.2b4+ cut off on the same base. Shorts removal via NoShortsEver. Genuine version string.
